title: FlyBlocks
description: 🎯 Grant flight for a specific number of blocks.
body:
# **✈️ FlyBlocks - Controlled Flight with Block Limits**

## 🛠️ Features:
1. 🎯 Grant flight for a specific number of blocks.
2. ⛔ Block flight in specific worlds.
3. 📊 Dynamic action bar showing remaining flight blocks.
4. ⏬ Automatic Slow Falling effect when flight ends (prevents fall damage).
5. ⚙️ Configurable messages and sounds.
6. 🔁 Easy /flyblocks reload command for live config updates.

Join our discord server for support or ideas! 
[https://discord.gg/nfEfhJQvyn](https://discord.gg/nfEfhJQvyn)


## 💬 Example Command:

```
/flyblocks <player> <blocks>
```

**Gives a player the ability to fly for a set number of blocks.**
